events.credibility_reason: Claim restricted to quadratic f (a changed question, not the conjecture for general f); order five vs eight discrepancy unresolved; priority dispute with Ahmad.
Restricted to the single equation t^M = a; evaluation count in the Kung-Traub sense unstated, so it does not bear on the bound for general f; theorem read only via a summariser.

why: The statement asks for the optimal order of memoryless multipoint iteration (the 2^(n-1) upper bound for general f). Only Wasilkowski 1981 settles a restriction of it (n <= 3, Hermite, well-poised Birkhoff information), so it is a pre-snapshot case. The optimal-method constructions (Varona, Chang, Ullah, Sagar-Sharma) each attain the bound at one evaluation count already known to be attainable; they are finitely many instances and leave the upper bound untouched. Babajee and Schiessl work on restricted function classes (quadratics; t^M = a), where the general-f complexity bound does not apply as stated, so both are variants rather than counterexamples. Cima et al. and Ahmad's comment settle nothing. No AI system is named anywhere. Chang's date is year-only 2024, so it is null; Ullah is taken at the 2022 volume date per the record.
doubts: Ullah's first public date may be 2025-05-12 rather than 2022; it would not matter, since the event is instances. Wasilkowski's scope rests on a garbled abstract. AI-absence for the journal constructions rests on abstracts only.
